name: Arcade kart racer (3D)
oneLiner: A low-poly 3D kart race: a track built from a closed spline (road, kerbs, barriers, ramps, boost pads, start gantry with countdown lamps), karts with drivers auto-scaled so the wheels sit on the ground, arcade physics with grip, a hop-drift that charges a three-level boost, jumps and boost pads, checkpoint gates that only count in order, AI racers on a racing line with rubber-banding, a 3-2-1-GO countdown, race clock, lap splits, places, minimap and a finish screen. Karts face their velocity (yaw = atan2(dir.x, dir.z) + facingOffset). Seeded and fixed-step, with an autoplay driver.
fits: a racing mini-game inside a larger game (festival, hub world)
time trials and ghost-free lap challenges
a cup of short tracks with points
toy-car or creature racers that need drift-boost handling
notFor: simulation racing (no tyre model, no gears, no damage)
open-world driving without a lap track
combat items and weapons (not included; add them through the hooks)

needs: three.js 0.149.0 classic build loaded as window.THREE before the module
a canvas for WebGL and (optional) a 2D canvas on top for the HUD and addons
a fixed 60 Hz step that passes the player's input {steer, throttle, brake, drift}
a track definition (closed list of points) and a list of racers
provides: events: countdown, go, checkpoint, lap, finish, raceEnd, allFinished, boost, driftStart, driftEnd, jump, land, bump, wall, wrongWay, respawn
karts() with x, y, z, heading, speed, lap, next gate, place, lap times, drift and boost state; results() with times and places
anchor(id) -> screen px of a kart (world -> screen); project(x, y, z)
drawHud(ctx, w, h, opts): place, lap, clock, splits, minimap, speed, drift meter, countdown and banners; hudRects()
state(): {t, phase, actors:[{id, x, z, yaw, moveDir, forward, facesMove, feetY, lap, next, place, ...}]} for checks
autoInput(id) / setAI(id, on): the AI driver for any kart (autoplay)
checkTrack(def): problems of a new track before it ships

assets: module/kart-racer-3d.js (global GameDNA_KartRacer3D; needs three.js 0.149.0 as window.THREE, copied as three.min.js next to the page). Karts, drivers, track, scenery and textures are procedural (primitives and code-drawn canvas textures). No external files besides three.min.js.
